entry.title: Joining Resoniks as Machine Learning Lead
entry.summary: After two decades in academia, I've joined Resoniks as Machine Learning Lead, moving from research into building AI-powered acoustic testing for manufacturing quality control.
entry.content: After two decades in academia, I've joined Resoniks as Machine Learning Lead. Resoniks builds an AI-powered acoustic testing system that gives a real-time pass/fail on parts, catching surface and internal structural defects without radiation, chemicals, or manual operator analysis. It's a shift from research to building: instead of asking what further research is needed, the answer now is "let's build it now."
